summary: Reproduced the candidate review at exact commit d501752c27de267fbc85dce32832d2a59cdba8bd. The candidate exactly fixes register and streaming overflow on gfx950 but leaves the CUDA-only TopKCluster truncation unchanged. Preserved its valid exact-key refinement and disabled CUDA cluster dispatch, routing affected long rows through the verified streaming path. This is a correctness-first fallback with a CUDA long-row performance limitation.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on the prepared base: the 8192, 32768, and 262144 overflow rows each had 2048/2048 selected-value mismatches; 2049 candidates had 2047 mismatches. The 2048 boundary and exact-tie control had zero mismatches.

tests.command: git checkout --detach d501752c27de267fbc85dce32832d2a59cdba8bd && git show 11aeb32eed938317d136dff87dbe751d010e7b94:reports/j-25b6a2c6b1b5/evidence/review_harness.py | PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-984f3cf7c2fd/jit-candidate /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-984f3cf7c2fd/venv/bin/python -
tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate verification: all eight independent register/streaming, boundary, exact-tie, long-row, and signed-subnormal cases had zero value-multiset mismatches versus torch.topk.
11 focused exactness tests passed on gfx950, including the dedicated batch-1, N=262144, 50,000-distinct-value regression.
All 289 tests in test_topk_v2.py passed on the assigned gfx950 GPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: Failing-before, exact-candidate, focused after, and full-suite numerical tests ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_limitations: No CUDA/B200 device was available. The CUDA cluster counterexample was established from dispatch and source inspection, and the correction avoids that path, but CUDA compilation/runtime and the performance impact were not measured.
Disabling TopKCluster can reduce CUDA performance for long rows and small batches; correctness is provided by TopKStreaming until a cluster-wide exact refinement is implemented and validated.
No GLM-5.2 weights, reported real score dumps, TP8, or multi-node environment were available; no full-model or workload-level claim is made.
